AI Overview
Geodle refers to a few different free, daily geography-based puzzle games inspired by Wordle. 
Reddit
·r/geoguessr
 +1
Main Variations of Geodle
Country-to-Country Route Puzzle (geodle.io): You are given a starting country and a target mystery country. Your goal is to build the most efficient chain of connected countries (using real-world land borders or fixed crossings) to reach the destination in as few steps as possible. A new puzzle drops daily at midnight UTC. 
Mystery Country Demographic Guess (geodle.me): You have a limited number of tries to guess a daily secret country based on demographic and regional clues like population, religion, average temperature, continent, and government type.

Spatial & Distance Clue Version (wordleunlimited2.io): You guess a mystery country or territory and receive feedback detailing the distance in kilometers or miles, a directional arrow, and regional data.
